I have a Discussion about the use of some modis.
The same modi can't be played by a vampire during an action.
But there's some modis that can be played by diferent minions. (mask of 1000
faces or cloack the gath) that are played by other than the actin minion.
explain me what happens. Thanks.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
i938...@petra.euitio.uniovi.es (Ignacio Colunga Cantero) writes:

> I have a Discussion about the use of some modis.
> The same modi can't be played by a vampire during an action.
> But there's some modis that can be played by diferent minions. (mask of 1000
> faces or cloack the gath) that are played by other than the actin minion.
> explain me what happens. Thanks.

Each vampire (or minion, for that matter) may play a copy of a given
action modifier only once per action.

So, each of your ready (non-acting) vampires with superior obfuscate could
play superior Cloak the Gathering to give the acting minion +1 stealth per.
If the acting minion was a vampire with obfuscate, then he could also play
Cloak the Gathering (inferior) for an additional +1 stealth.

You could Mask the action to a new acting vampire as many times as you
wish, with another +1 stealth each time you did so with superior ob.
